paths.title: Training agents with RL
paths.lead: Train a 1.7B model to crack safes it has never seen, then measure it against frontier models, per safe and per dollar. Nine stages over Hugging Face's Training Agents series; each one moves your scoreboard up a rung, and the last one is the thread you post.
paths.overviewText: See all nine stages, the GPU budget and the known gotchas →

days.label: Stages 0–1
days.title: RL from zero
days.blurb: Crack safes by hand, watch the baselines fail, then a Q-table that works on one safe and nowhere else.

days.label: Stages 2–3
days.title: Agents and how to measure them
days.blurb: Measure the frontier models you have to beat, then build the environment and score the untrained model.

days.label: Stages 4–6
days.title: Train it: SFT, distillation, GRPO
days.blurb: SFT on a probing script's games, optional distillation, then GRPO: three rungs, three numbers.

days.label: Stages 7–8
days.title: Your environment and the post
days.blurb: Your safe on the Hub, bigger held-out safes, the cost per safe cracked, and the thread.

mission.claim: Train a 1.7B model to crack safes it has never seen, and beat frontier models at it, per safe and per dollar.

classic.lead: From never having run reinforcement learning to training an LLM agent on a game nobody has trained on. Nine stages over Hugging Face's Training Agents series, grouped into four parts. Each stage has a primer, timestamped viewing, real scripts to run and a checkpoint.
classic.overviewText: See all nine stages, the GPU budget and the known gotchas →

days.label: Stages 0–1
days.title: RL from zero
days.blurb: Set up, then one hard day: returns, Q-learning, policy gradients, PPO and GRPO, worked by hand.

days.label: Stages 2–3
days.title: Agents and how to measure them
days.blurb: Agent traces, pass@k and error bars, then what changes when the policy is an agent.

days.label: Stages 4–6
days.title: Train it: SFT, distillation, GRPO
days.blurb: Fine-tune on agent traces, copy a teacher, then RL with rewards a program can check.

days.label: Stages 7–8
days.title: Environments and your game
days.blurb: The reward becomes a place you act in, then the capstone: teach an agent Tumblers.

paths.title: Build an LLM yourself
paths.lead: Train a GPT from scratch on US weather-service forecast discussions, and find how much text it needs before it beats GPT-2 fine-tuned on the same text, in bits per byte. Six days over Raschka's Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), mostly on a laptop; each day moves your scoreboard up a rung. New to this? Each move links the LLM basics card it needs.
paths.overviewText: See the mission: the post, the ladder and the fairness rules →

days.label: Day 0
days.title: Your corpus, and the number to beat
days.blurb: Download the forecast discussions and score a compressor, a byte bigram and GPT-2 zero-shot.

days.label: Days 1–2
days.title: Bigram, tokens and the loader
days.blurb: PyTorch and what training does, then batches and attention, each ending with a number on your corpus.

days.label: Days 3–4
days.title: Your GPT, then the sweep
days.blurb: Train your first GPT on forecast text, then 4 sizes × 5 corpus sizes against GPT-2 fine-tuned.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Blind test and the post
days.blurb: Chapters 6–7, a real-or-fake test on friends, and the thread with every curve.

mission.claim: Find out how much domain text a tiny GPT trained from scratch needs before it beats fine-tuned GPT-2, in bits per byte on weather-service forecast discussions.

classic.lead: Code a GPT from an empty file to an assistant, following Sebastian Raschka's Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch) chapter by chapter, with Karpathy's Zero to Hero for depth. Five days of mostly typing code on a laptop. Do LLM basics first: every step links back to the card that explains what you're building.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Tools, and what training does
days.blurb: PyTorch from the book's appendix A, then backprop and a bigram model with Zero to Hero.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Text → batches, then attention
days.blurb: Chapters 2 and 3: the data loader, then self-attention up to multi-head.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: The GPT model
days.blurb: Chapter 4: the block, the model in GPT-2's shape, and generating text.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Pretrain it
days.blurb: Chapter 5 and appendix D: train, decode, load GPT-2's weights. Stretch: real pretraining.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Make it useful
days.blurb: Chapters 6 and 7 and appendix E: a classifier, an assistant, a judge, LoRA.

reference.title: How an LLM turns text into an answer

paths.title: The LLM inference study path
paths.lead: Why an LLM answers as fast as it does, from the wait you see as a user down to running and pricing a fleet of them. Nine days, taken in order. Each day is a plan over the courses below, with priming, pretests and checkpoints built in.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Why a response takes as long as it does
days.blurb: Time to first token, output speed and length, and why agents take minutes. No ML background needed.

days.label: Day 1.5
days.title: Just enough about the model
days.blurb: What a model, a token and one forward pass are, and how a base model becomes an assistant.
days.tag: New to ML? Do this one

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Inside the GPU and the engine loop
days.blurb: What one decode step does to a GPU, how to measure it, and why a server batches.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: The math of serving
days.blurb: The step-time formula, why memory decides the batch, and how one chip becomes a fleet.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Measure a real server
days.blurb: How to load-test, why the curve has a knee and what to watch, then the load-curve lab on a rented GPU.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Build the scheduler
days.blurb: The part of an engine that decides what runs on every step, built in Python, then matched to vLLM.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Memory is the product
days.blurb: FlashAttention, smaller KV per token, KV memory in pages, and reusing it across requests.

days.label: Day 7
days.title: Cheaper decode
days.blurb: Inside vLLM and SGLang, quantization, speculative decoding and forced JSON, then the prediction-ledger project.

days.label: Day 8
days.title: Scale out
days.blurb: Splitting a model across GPUs, prefill and decode on different GPUs, and mixture of experts.

days.label: Day 9
days.title: Operate and price a fleet
days.blurb: Many replicas, cold starts, the cost of a token and safe releases, then the last project and the capstone.

later.label: Then
later.title: Agents, and the optional extras
later.blurb: The Agents path, plus the rest of the Structured outputs, Kernels and training courses.

paths.title: How a coding agent works
paths.lead: What a coding agent actually is, from the bare loop to measuring whether a change helped. Three days, taken in order, best after Day 1 of the inference path. Each day reads the Agents field guide's best sources with its questions and checkpoints, and ends with a small build.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: The loop and its tools
days.blurb: A model called in a loop, the tools it can use, and a 60-line agent you run yourself.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: What the model sees, and what it may do
days.blurb: Context engineering; skills, MCP, subagents and hooks; sandboxes and prompt injection.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Did it work? Evals and trajectories
days.blurb: Hidden tests, repeats and honest intervals, reading failed runs, and cost per solved task.

later.label: Go further
later.title: The full Agents projects
later.blurb: A real harness, a benchmark and an ablation table, each with a pass/fail test.

paths.title: How reasoning models work
paths.lead: How a model that predicts the next word becomes one that reasons, for someone with no deep-learning background. Four days, taken in order: the basics every method reuses, how assistants are trained on preferences, thinking at inference time, and training reasoning with RL. Each day pairs cards written for this path with the Models field guide's sources and checkpoints.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Just enough about the model
days.blurb: Gradients, next-token prediction, sampling, and the four upgrades since the 2017 transformer. No ML background needed.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: From text predictor to assistant
days.blurb: Reinforcement learning from zero, reward models trained on preferences, and DPO.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Thinking at inference time
days.blurb: Chain-of-thought, voting, grading each step, and spending more compute where it helps.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Learning to reason with RL
days.blurb: STaR, GRPO with rewards a script can check, and how DeepSeek-R1 was built.
